diagnostics.message: :resource.aws_config_configuration_aggregator.organization references the organization role but does not wait for :resource.aws_iam_role_policy_attachment.config_organization. Attach AWSConfigRoleForOrganizations before creating the organization aggregator so Config can retrieve organization details; the provider's official example explicitly orders these resources.

module.cloudtrail_baseline:resource.aws_cloudtrail.global must wait for module.cloudtrail_baseline:resource.aws_iam_role_policy.cloudwatch_delivery_policy when CloudWatch delivery is enabled. Referencing the role ARN orders role creation, not installation of the logs:CreateLogStream and logs:PutLogEvents permissions CloudTrail needs when configuring delivery.

module.cloudtrail_baseline:resource.aws_cloudtrail.global references the SNS topic but does not wait for module.cloudtrail_baseline:resource.aws_sns_topic_policy.local-account-cloudtrail. When SNS notifications are enabled, install the policy granting cloudtrail.amazonaws.com sns:Publish before configuring the trail, otherwise creation can fail with insufficient SNS topic permissions.

In ap-northeast-1, aws_default_subnet.default must wait for aws_default_vpc.default. The default subnet resource adopts or creates a subnet in the default VPC, but cannot create that VPC itself. Without ordering, an account whose default VPC was deleted can fail during subnet creation.

The ap-northeast-1 flow log must wait for aws_iam_role_policy.flow_logs_publish_policy when CloudWatch delivery is selected. Its role ARN reference waits only for role creation, allowing logging to start before the role has permission to create streams and publish events. Establish this ordering through the root VPC module call.

The ap-northeast-1 Config delivery channel must wait for aws_iam_role_policy.recorder_publish_policy, which grants its recorder role S3 delivery and SNS publishing permissions. Waiting for the recorder and role does not wait for that policy. Pass a dependency into the delivery channel; a whole-module dependency on this policy would cycle through the module's SNS topic output.

The ap-northeast-1 recorder status enables AWS Config without waiting for aws_iam_role_policy_attachment.recorder_read_policy. Role creation alone does not install AWS_ConfigRole; order recorder startup after this attachment so recording starts with resource-discovery permissions.

In ap-northeast-2, aws_default_subnet.default must wait for aws_default_vpc.default. The subnet resource adopts or creates a subnet in the default VPC but cannot create the VPC; parallel execution can fail when the default VPC is initially absent.

The ap-northeast-2 flow log must wait for aws_iam_role_policy.flow_logs_publish_policy for CloudWatch delivery. Establish ordering through the root VPC module call to avoid starting delivery with an unprivileged role.
